Known for their Chuck Taylor All Star classics, Converse offers a range of footwear for various lifestyles, from casual to active wear. Explore their collection of sneakers, bags, and accessories that blend comfort, durability, and fashion. Perfect for the young and young-at-heart, Converse is a go-to destination for those who value style and self-expression.

entries.description: Experience the ultimate convenience at Mr. Jeff, located at One Uptown Residence. As a trusted laundry shop, they offer top-notch laundry services that will make your life easier. From washing to folding, Mr. Jeff's team ensures that your clothes are cleaned and cared for with the utmost attention to detail. Visit them today and enjoy the comfort of having your laundry taken care of while you shop or dine at Megaworld's One Uptown Residence.

entries.description: Discover the art of contemporary elegance at V! Jewelry, located on the second floor of Uptown Mall. This Filipino-owned brand is celebrated for its modern take on fine jewelry, showcasing a stunning collection of natural pearls, ethically sourced gemstones, and 14k to 18k solid gold pieces. With a focus on "everyday luxury," V! Jewelry offers versatile designs that transition seamlessly from professional settings to evening celebrations.

entries.description: Discover the perfect fusion of fashion and function at Sprinto, located on the second floor of Uptown Mall. As a leader in high-performance eyewear, this shop offers a premium selection of polarized sunglasses, anti-blue light gaming glasses, and high-impact sports lenses designed for the modern trailblazer. With a focus on cutting-edge lens technology and hypoallergenic frames, Sprinto provides stylish, protective eyewear that caters to the fast-paced lifestyle.
